root_cause: Adding rigid kinematic thresholding and heuristic motion clamps (e.g., max angular speed limits, parallax degenerate thresholds) that zero out or distort valid high-angle relative motions.

details.rule: Do not hardcode artificial kinematic constraints or arbitrary parallax zeroing logic in low-level epipolar geometry pipelines. Let RANSAC/MAGSAC inlier ratios and pure Cheirality triangulations evaluate pose candidate validity.
